chunks: As for what Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Ḥumayd ibn al-Muthannā, who said:

I asked Abā al-Ḥasan al-Awwal عليه السلام about a pregnant woman who sees one gush or two gushes of blood during the days, and in a month, and in two months. He said: “That is bleeding; it does not prevent this woman from salat (prayer).”

key_terms.الدُّفْقَتَيْنِ: two gushes or two brief flows

ai.seo_question: Does occasional bleeding during pregnancy stop a woman from performing salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a pregnant woman who experiences occasional small gushes of blood. Imam Abū al-Ḥasan al-Awwal عليه السلام states that such blood is considered bleeding and does not prevent her from performing salat (prayer), indicating that it is not treated as hayd in this case.
